purpose: Task C provenance-search handoff for the 95 Batch 1-3 legacy red flags (all pending_provenance). Extractor: for EACH flag find whitelisted official passages that support the whole claim — MedlinePlus / NIH institutes / CDC; FDA-DailyMed only for medication contexts. Deliver source_url + section + verbatim quote_en (≤40 words) + suggested_tier + the flag id it supports. Never rewrite/add/delete a flag; a flag with no findable support goes to not_found with the pages checked. Output shape: the accepted cond_batch4 Task C supplement format, but each evidence entry MUST carry supports_red_flag_id (the rf.* id below) — full-text linkage, no truncated notes.

flags.text_zh: 頻繁或持續性臉部疼痛，尤其一般止痛藥無效且牙科已排除牙源性原因時，應接受醫療評估
flags.text_en: Frequent or persistent facial pain should be medically assessed, particularly when standard painkillers do not help and dental causes have been ruled out

flags.text_zh: 鞍區麻木、大小便失禁 → 馬尾症候群，急診
flags.text_en: Saddle anaesthesia, bowel/bladder incontinence → cauda equina, emergency

flags.text_zh: 夜間痛、體重減輕、癌症病史 → 排除轉移或腫瘤
flags.text_en: Night pain, weight loss, cancer history → rule out metastasis or tumour

flags.text_zh: 發燒、靜脈藥癮、免疫低下 → 排除脊椎感染
flags.text_en: Fever, IV drug use, immunosuppression → rule out spinal infection

flags.text_zh: 重大外傷或骨鬆長者輕微外力後痛 → 排除壓迫性骨折
flags.text_en: Major trauma, or minor force in osteoporotic elderly → rule out compression fracture

flags.text_zh: 下肢放射痛或麻木無力 → 考慮神經根受壓而非單純拉傷
flags.text_en: Radiating leg pain or numbness/weakness → consider nerve root involvement, not simple strain

flags.text_zh: 馬尾徵象（鞍麻、失禁）→ 急診
flags.text_en: Cauda equina signs (saddle numbness, incontinence) → emergency

flags.text_zh: 外傷後劇痛無法負重 → 排除骨折
flags.text_en: Severe pain unable to bear weight after trauma → rule out fracture

flags.text_zh: 馬尾症候群（鞍麻、失禁、雙側無力）→ 急診手術
flags.text_en: Cauda equina syndrome (saddle numbness, incontinence, bilateral weakness) → emergency surgery

flags.text_zh: 進行性足下垂或明顯肌力下降 → 神經外科評估
flags.text_en: Progressive foot drop or marked weakness → neurosurgical assessment

flags.text_zh: 發燒或癌症病史 → 排除感染或腫瘤
flags.text_en: Fever or cancer history → rule out infection or tumour

flags.text_zh: 鞍區麻木、大小便失禁或滯留、雙下肢無力 → 馬尾症候群，急診轉介
flags.text_en: Saddle anaesthesia, bowel or bladder incontinence/retention, bilateral leg weakness → cauda equina syndrome, emergency referral

flags.text_zh: 進行性足下垂或明顯肌力下降 → 需影像與神經外科評估
flags.text_en: Progressive foot drop or marked motor loss → needs imaging and neurosurgical assessment

flags.text_zh: 夜間痛合併體重減輕、發燒或癌症病史 → 排除腫瘤或感染
flags.text_en: Night pain with weight loss, fever, or cancer history → rule out tumour or infection

flags.text_zh: 步態不穩、手部精細動作變差、Hoffmann/Babinski 陽性 → 脊髓病變，需影像與轉介
flags.text_en: Unsteady gait, clumsy hands, positive Hoffmann/Babinski → cervical myelopathy, image and refer

flags.text_zh: 進行性上肢無力或萎縮 → 神經根/脊髓受壓
flags.text_en: Progressive arm weakness or wasting → root/cord compression

flags.text_zh: 發燒、體重減輕 → 排除感染或腫瘤
flags.text_en: Fever, weight loss → rule out infection or tumour

flags.text_zh: 發燒合併頸部僵硬、畏光 → 排除腦膜炎（急症）
flags.text_en: Fever with neck stiffness and photophobia → rule out meningitis (emergency)

flags.text_zh: 外傷後頸痛 → 排除骨折或韌帶損傷，勿貿然活動
flags.text_en: Neck pain after trauma → rule out fracture or ligament injury, do not force motion

flags.text_zh: 上肢放射麻木無力 → 考慮神經根病變
flags.text_en: Radiating arm numbness/weakness → consider radiculopathy

conditions.name_zh: 揮鞭式頸部損傷（文件情境）

flags.text_zh: 中線骨性壓痛、麻木無力、意識改變（加拿大頸椎準則陽性）→ 影像排除骨折/脫位
flags.text_en: Midline bony tenderness, numbness/weakness, altered consciousness (positive Canadian C-spine rule) → image to exclude fracture/dislocation

flags.text_zh: 進行性神經症狀 → 神經外科評估
flags.text_en: Progressive neurological symptoms → neurosurgical assessment

flags.text_zh: 劇烈頭痛或吞嚥、發聲異常 → 排除血管損傷
flags.text_en: Severe headache or swallowing/voice change → rule out vascular injury

flags.text_zh: 外傷後突發無力或畸形 → 排除旋轉肌撕裂或骨折
flags.text_en: Sudden weakness or deformity after trauma → rule out rotator cuff tear or fracture

flags.text_zh: 夜間痛合併體重減輕或發燒 → 排除感染或腫瘤
flags.text_en: Night pain with weight loss or fever → rule out infection or tumour

flags.text_zh: 被動活動不受限卻無力 → 可能是旋轉肌問題而非冰凍肩
flags.text_en: Full passive range but weakness → likely rotator cuff, not adhesive capsulitis

flags.text_zh: 急性外傷後無法主動外展手臂 → 疑全層撕裂，需影像與轉介
flags.text_en: Cannot actively abduct the arm after acute trauma → suspect full-thickness tear, image and refer

flags.text_zh: 合併頸部放射痛或手麻 → 排除頸神經根病變
flags.text_en: With radiating neck pain or hand numbness → rule out cervical radiculopathy

flags.text_zh: 夜間痛合併發燒 → 排除感染
flags.text_en: Night pain with fever → rule out infection

flags.text_zh: 外上髁腫脹發熱 → 排除感染或發炎性關節病
flags.text_en: Warmth and swelling over the epicondyle → rule out infection or inflammatory arthropathy

flags.text_zh: 合併手麻或無力 → 排除橈神經（後骨間神經）夾擠
flags.text_en: With hand numbness or weakness → rule out radial (posterior interosseous) nerve entrapment

flags.text_zh: 外傷後劇痛 → 排除撕脫性骨折
flags.text_en: Severe pain after trauma → rule out avulsion fracture

flags.text_zh: 合併第四、五指麻木無力 → 排除尺神經（肘管）病變
flags.text_en: With numbness/weakness of the ring and little fingers → rule out ulnar nerve (cubital tunnel) involvement

flags.text_zh: 紅熱腫脹 → 排除感染
flags.text_en: Redness, warmth, swelling → rule out infection

flags.text_zh: 外傷後劇痛 → 排除撕脫性骨折
flags.text_en: Severe pain after trauma → rule out avulsion fracture

flags.text_zh: 進行性大魚際肌萎縮或持續麻木 → 需神經傳導檢查與轉介，考慮手術減壓
flags.text_en: Progressive thenar wasting or constant numbness → needs nerve conduction study and referral; consider surgical release

flags.text_zh: 雙側合併全身症狀 → 排除甲狀腺低下、類風濕、澱粉樣變
flags.text_en: Bilateral with systemic symptoms → rule out hypothyroidism, rheumatoid arthritis, amyloidosis

flags.text_zh: 外傷後急性腫脹麻木 → 排除急性腕隧道症候群（急症）
flags.text_en: Acute swelling and numbness after trauma → rule out acute carpal tunnel syndrome (emergency)

flags.text_zh: 紅熱腫脹 → 排除感染性腱鞘炎（急症）
flags.text_en: Redness, warmth and swelling → rule out infectious tenosynovitis (emergency)

flags.text_zh: 合併麻木 → 排除橈神經淺支刺激
flags.text_en: With numbness → rule out superficial radial nerve irritation

flags.text_zh: 外傷後劇痛 → 排除橈骨莖突骨折
flags.text_en: Severe pain after trauma → rule out radial styloid fracture

flags.text_zh: 紅熱腫脹 → 排除感染性腱鞘炎（急症）
flags.text_en: Redness, warmth, swelling → rule out infectious tenosynovitis (emergency)

flags.text_zh: 外傷後鎖住 → 排除肌腱斷裂或異物
flags.text_en: Locking after trauma → rule out tendon rupture or foreign body

flags.text_zh: 多指同時受累 → 考慮糖尿病、類風濕等全身病因
flags.text_en: Multiple fingers involved → consider systemic causes such as diabetes or rheumatoid arthritis

flags.text_zh: 紅、熱、劇痛、發燒 → 排除化膿性關節炎或痛風（急症）
flags.text_en: Red, hot, severely painful joint with fever → rule out septic arthritis or gout (emergency)

flags.text_zh: 外傷後鎖住或明顯不穩 → 排除半月板或韌帶損傷
flags.text_en: Locking or gross instability after trauma → rule out meniscal or ligament injury

flags.text_zh: 晨僵超過一小時、多關節對稱 → 排除類風濕性關節炎
flags.text_en: Morning stiffness over an hour, symmetric polyarthritis → rule out rheumatoid arthritis

flags.text_zh: 關節腫脹積液 → 排除關節內損傷（半月板、軟骨）
flags.text_en: Joint effusion → rule out intra-articular injury (meniscus, cartilage)

flags.text_zh: 鎖住或打軟 → 排除半月板或韌帶問題
flags.text_en: Locking or giving way → rule out meniscal or ligament problem

flags.text_zh: 紅熱發燒 → 排除感染性關節炎
flags.text_en: Red, hot joint with fever → rule out septic arthritis

flags.text_zh: 真正鎖住無法伸直 → 桶柄狀撕裂，需轉介評估
flags.text_en: True locking with inability to extend → bucket-handle tear, refer for assessment

flags.text_zh: 外傷後大量積血（數小時內腫脹）→ 排除韌帶斷裂或骨軟骨骨折
flags.text_en: Large haemarthrosis (swelling within hours) after trauma → rule out ligament rupture or osteochondral fracture

flags.text_zh: 紅熱發燒 → 排除感染
flags.text_en: Red, hot joint with fever → rule out infection

flags.text_zh: 受傷後無法負重四步且骨性壓痛（Ottawa 踝準則陽性）→ 需 X 光排除骨折
flags.text_en: Unable to take four steps and bony tenderness (positive Ottawa ankle rules) → X-ray to exclude fracture

flags.text_zh: 明顯不穩或反覆扭傷 → 考慮韌帶完全斷裂或慢性不穩
flags.text_en: Gross instability or recurrent sprains → consider complete ligament rupture or chronic instability

flags.text_zh: 近端腓骨壓痛 → 排除 Maisonneuve 骨折
flags.text_en: Proximal fibular tenderness → rule out Maisonneuve fracture

flags.text_zh: 夜間痛或休息痛、外傷後無法負重 → 排除跟骨應力性骨折
flags.text_en: Night or rest pain, or inability to bear weight after trauma → rule out calcaneal stress fracture

flags.text_zh: 雙側跟痛合併其他關節症狀 → 考慮發炎性關節病（如僵直性脊椎炎）
flags.text_en: Bilateral heel pain with other joint symptoms → consider inflammatory arthropathy (e.g. ankylosing spondylitis)

flags.text_zh: 足底麻木或灼痛 → 考慮神經夾擠而非筋膜炎
flags.text_en: Plantar numbness or burning → consider nerve entrapment rather than fasciitis

flags.text_zh: 突發後跟「被踢」感、無法墊腳、Thompson 測試陽性 → 跟腱斷裂，需轉介
flags.text_en: Sudden 'kicked in the heel' sensation, inability to push off, positive Thompson test → Achilles rupture, refer

flags.text_zh: 紅熱腫脹合併發燒 → 排除感染
flags.text_en: Redness, warmth and swelling with fever → rule out infection

flags.text_zh: 使用氟喹諾酮類抗生素 → 肌腱斷裂風險升高，須警覺
flags.text_en: On fluoroquinolone antibiotics → heightened rupture risk, stay alert

flags.text_zh: 休息痛、夜間痛、體重減輕 → 排除腫瘤或感染
flags.text_en: Rest or night pain with weight loss → rule out tumour or infection

flags.text_zh: 突發劇痛無法負重（尤其類固醇/酒精史）→ 排除股骨頭缺血性壞死或骨折
flags.text_en: Sudden severe pain unable to bear weight (esp. steroid/alcohol history) → rule out avascular necrosis or fracture

flags.text_zh: 紅熱發燒 → 排除化膿性關節炎
flags.text_en: Red, hot joint with fever → rule out septic arthritis

flags.text_zh: 腰痛合併皮節分布麻木無力 → 優先排除腰椎神經根病變
flags.text_en: Back pain with dermatomal numbness/weakness → first rule out lumbar radiculopathy

flags.text_zh: 馬尾徵象 → 急診
flags.text_en: Cauda equina signs → emergency

flags.text_zh: 夜間痛、體重減輕 → 排除骨盆腫瘤
flags.text_en: Night pain, weight loss → rule out pelvic tumour

flags.text_zh: 發燒、體重減輕、關節腫脹、皮疹 → 排除發炎性/自體免疫疾病
flags.text_en: Fever, weight loss, joint swelling, rash → rule out inflammatory/autoimmune disease

flags.text_zh: 近端無力、肌酵素升高 → 排除肌炎
flags.text_en: Proximal weakness with raised muscle enzymes → rule out myositis

flags.text_zh: 局部固定痛而非廣泛痛 → 重新考慮結構性病因
flags.text_en: Fixed focal pain rather than widespread → reconsider a structural cause

flags.text_zh: 合併全身廣泛壓痛、疲勞、睡眠障礙 → 考慮纖維肌痛而非局部肌筋膜痛
flags.text_en: Widespread tenderness, fatigue and sleep disturbance → consider fibromyalgia rather than localised myofascial pain

flags.text_zh: 發燒、體重減輕 → 排除感染或腫瘤
flags.text_en: Fever, weight loss → rule out infection or tumour

flags.text_zh: 進行性神經症狀 → 排除神經根或脊髓病變
flags.text_en: Progressive neurological symptoms → rule out radiculopathy or myelopathy

flags.text_zh: 顎關節鎖死無法開口/閉口 → 需轉介
flags.text_en: Jaw locked open or closed → refer

flags.text_zh: 外傷後咬合改變或劇痛 → 排除下頜骨折或脫位
flags.text_en: Bite change or severe pain after trauma → rule out mandibular fracture or dislocation

flags.text_zh: 進行性面部麻木無力 → 排除神經或腫瘤病因
flags.text_en: Progressive facial numbness/weakness → rule out neurological or tumour cause

flags.text_zh: 霹靂性（瞬間達最強）頭痛 → 排除蛛網膜下腔出血（急症）
flags.text_en: Thunderclap (instant maximal) headache → rule out subarachnoid haemorrhage (emergency)

flags.text_zh: 發燒合併頸僵、畏光 → 排除腦膜炎
flags.text_en: Fever with neck stiffness and photophobia → rule out meningitis

flags.text_zh: 新發於 50 歲以上、漸進惡化、神經缺損、清晨嘔吐 → 影像排除腫瘤/顱內壓升高
flags.text_en: New onset over age 50, progressive, focal deficit, morning vomiting → image to exclude tumour/raised ICP

flags.text_zh: 霹靂性頭痛 → 排除蛛網膜下腔出血（急症）
flags.text_en: Thunderclap headache → rule out subarachnoid haemorrhage (emergency)

flags.text_zh: 頭痛型態明顯改變、進行性惡化、神經缺損持續 → 影像評估
flags.text_en: Marked change in pattern, progressive worsening, persistent deficit → image

flags.text_zh: 發燒合併頸僵 → 排除腦膜炎
flags.text_en: Fever with neck stiffness → rule out meningitis

flags.text_zh: 先兆持續逾一小時或每次同側 → 需進一步評估
flags.text_en: Aura lasting over an hour or always the same side → needs further assessment

flags.text_zh: 首次發作或型態改變 → 影像排除次發性病因（如海綿竇病灶）
flags.text_en: First-ever attack or change in pattern → image to exclude a secondary cause (e.g. cavernous sinus lesion)

flags.text_zh: 霹靂性頭痛 → 排除出血（急症）
flags.text_en: Thunderclap headache → rule out haemorrhage (emergency)

flags.text_zh: 持續神經缺損 → 進一步評估
flags.text_en: Persistent neurological deficit → further assessment

flags.text_zh: 胸、下顎、頸部或手臂疼痛
flags.text_en: Pain in the chest, jaw, neck, or arm

flags.text_zh: 吞嚥困難或吞嚥疼痛
flags.text_en: Difficulty or pain with swallowing

flags.text_zh: 頻繁嘔吐或嘔血
flags.text_en: Frequent vomiting or bloody vomit

flags.text_zh: 嚴重且持續的腹痛
flags.text_en: Severe and constant abdominal pain

flags.text_zh: 呼吸困難
flags.text_en: Shortness of breath

flags.text_zh: 非刻意體重減輕或食慾喪失
flags.text_en: Unintentional weight loss or loss of appetite

flags.text_zh: 眼睛或皮膚發黃
flags.text_en: Yellowing of the eyes or skin

flags.text_zh: 黑色柏油樣糞便
flags.text_en: Black, tarry stools
